# AIGEOKit

> Free, privacy-first Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) tools running 100% client-side.

## Core Tools

- [/tools/llm-txt-builder/](https://www.aigeokit.com/tools/llm-txt-builder/): Free online llms.txt and llms-full.txt generator & validator.
- [/tools/ai-robots-txt-checker/](https://www.aigeokit.com/tools/ai-robots-txt-checker/): Check if GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, and OAI-SearchBot are blocked.
- [/tools/schema-generator/](https://www.aigeokit.com/tools/schema-generator/): Generate JSON-LD structured data with GEO Readiness score.
- [/tools/](https://www.aigeokit.com/tools/): Complete catalog of free GEO webmaster tools.

## Products

- [AI Visibility Checker](https://www.aigeokit.com/ai-visibility-checker/): Evaluate how discoverable a brand is across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and AI search. Explains the four-dimension AI visibility model (Brand Entity, Content Signals, Citation Readiness, AI Presence) with a sample 100-point score report. Demo preview — live analysis coming soon.
- [GEO Audit Report](https://www.aigeokit.com/geo-audit/): Request a hand-reviewed audit of how AI systems see a brand — AI visibility analysis, competitor comparison, citation opportunities and an optimization roadmap.
